reason: Our current system has worked for years and the vendor knows our club; I'm not going to put a switch in front of a volunteer board and a members' meeting for a two-person company that has no club live yet. Even the founding price of about € 270 a month for our 550 members is real money for a 9-hole club.
objection: Our members are mostly over 60. Clinics and a printed guide are nice, but I fear half of them never install the app, the desk ends up doing everything for them, and I'm the board member who pushed for it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle live for a season, with a results page showing older members actually using the app, and a phone call with their board saying the switch-over cost their volunteers nothing.
